units.source_text: 纪在昌悼右大将藤原保忠诗有“天与善人吾不信，右将军墓草初秋”之句。

en.t: In Ji Zaichang's poem mourning the Right General Fujiwara no Yasutada, there is a line: "I do not believe Heaven favors good people; the grass on the Right General's grave is in early autumn."

units.source_text: 因为现在不是秋天，故把“秋”字改为“青”字。

en.t: Because it is not autumn now, the character for "autumn" was changed to the character for "green."
